exposure: APGAR score at one minute and five minutes
outcome: Correlation between antenatal and postnatal UCI
Association of abnormal UCI with adverse perinatal outcomes
cohort: Pregnant women who underwent antenatal and postnatal UCI assessment (sample size not specified)
finding: There is a strong correlation between antenatal and postnatal umbilical cord coiling index, and abnormal UCI can be used as a predictor of adverse perinatal outcomes.
mod_finding: Hyper and hypo coiling are associated with an increased risk of emergency lower segment cesarean section (LSCS).
